claims.fact: China's NMPA reported conditional marketing approval for garsorasib tablets.
The indication covered adults with advanced non-small cell lung cancer bearing the KRAS G12C mutation after at least one systemic treatment.
The English notice identifies 19 February 2025 as the page update date. The decision date is unspecified.

clinical.subject: Garsorasib tablets
clinical.population: Adults with advanced non-small cell lung cancer with a KRAS G12C mutation who had received at least one systemic treatment.
clinical.indication: Previously treated advanced KRAS G12C-mutated non-small cell lung cancer in adults.

public_copy.root: Background | An English notice updated 19 Feb 2025 reports that China granted conditional marketing approval for garsorasib tablets for adults with advanced non-small cell lung cancer with a KRAS G12C mutation after at least one systemic treatment. https://english.nmpa.gov.cn/2025-02/19/c_1073628.htm
public_copy.video: What does the date on China's garsorasib notice tell us? The regulator updated its English page on 19 Feb 2025. It described a conditional approval and identified the patient group. The exact decision date is unspecified. https://english.nmpa.gov.cn/2025-02/19/c_1073628.htm
public_copy.alt: Historical background. China's regulator reported conditional approval of garsorasib tablets for adults who had received at least one systemic treatment for advanced non-small cell lung cancer with a KRAS G12C mutation. The notice was updated on 19 February 2025.
